Subject: Exec entry & access briefing — Novapower demo

Hi Evan / Karina,

Thanks again for scheduling the 22 Oct demo. A couple quick items on our side to make sure VP/CIO-level arrival goes smoothly on-site:

- Can you confirm the final executive attendee list (name, title, mobile) for Novapower? We need this for visitor passes and door access.
- Does your security team require pre-submitted IDs/scan? If so, please send the PII upload instructions or the secure share link.
- Recording policy / consent: please confirm whether the CTO or any exec requires the session to be non-recorded or limited.
- Arrival logistics: our execs usually arrive ~15 minutes early. Do you have a preferred lobby entrance and parking instructions for two guest vehicles?

I attached the latest Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf and an Exec_Access_Checklist (short checklist for security) — those are both shared in the Drive link below.

Ben and Jordan from my team will handle on-site escort and the quick pre-brief. Ben — can you review the checklist and confirm escort plan?

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
:hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf (agenda, 2 pages), Exec_Access_Checklist.xlsx (access steps, 1 sheet)
Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NOVAPOWER-ACCESS

From: Evan Rios <evan.rios@novapower.io>

Subject: Re: Exec entry & access briefing — Novapower demo

Hannah — thanks for the note and docs. Quick answers below: 

- Final execs: Priya Sen (CTO), Marcus Holt (VP Engineering). Priya will be the primary technical sponsor; Marcus will likely be present for the first 20 mins then back to other commitments.
- IDs: yes — our security team requests a one-time ID upload (name + government ID image). Karina will email a secure upload link by EOD.
- Recording: Priya is fine with recording for internal notes, but Marcus prefers a no-recording window for the first 25 minutes. We can accommodate a partial recording if Redwood can stop/pause recording on request.
- Lobby & parking: Main Plaza entrance (37 Plaza Ave). Visitor parking is in Lot B; please print Guest Voucher B2 or send license numbers and we will register them.

I've attached the Visitor_Passes.csv (names and email addresses) and looped in Novapower Security for any follow-ups.

Looking forward to it — Evan

--
Evan Rios
Head of Solutions | Novapower
evan.rios@novapower.io

Attachments: Visitor_Passes.csv (3 rows: Priya Sen, Marcus Holt, Liam Brooks (security contact))

> Hannah — thanks for the note and docs. Quick answers below:
> - Final execs: Priya Sen (CTO), Marcus Holt (VP Engineering).

Thanks Evan — helpful. Team, here's the plan from Redwood side: 

1) Arrival & escort
- Redwood execs (Hannah + 1) will aim to arrive 15 minutes before the 10:00 demo start (09:45 on-site).
- I will be the on-site escort and meet them at the Main Plaza lobby.
- Jordan, please have the pre-brief ready on my phone (5-min talking points).

2) Recording handling
- We'll be prepared to pause recording for the initial 25 minutes if requested by Marcus. Hannah, please confirm whether we will record and pause vs. not record at all. Technical ops can stop/pause in Zoom.

3) Visitor registration
- Evan: please send the secure upload link for IDs. If we get license numbers ahead of arrival, we'll forward them to you.

4) Contingency
- If an exec is delayed >10 minutes, we'll start the demo with senior PMs and slide in the exec briefing section when they arrive.

I'll attach a one-page Exec_Arrival_Note and will add the visitor names to the calendar invite once Karina confirms the upload link.

Ben

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

All —

Thanks, Evan and team — confirm received and we will proceed with the following final items for tomorrow's run: 

- Recording: Redwood will start the meeting recording but will stop for the first 25 minutes on request. Ben will be monitoring the recording toggle and will confirm live with Marcus before pausing.
- Visitor IDs: Karina, once we get the secure upload link, we'll forward Hannah's and Ben's IDs.
- Arrival time: Redwood execs will be on-site at 09:45. Ben will meet them in the Main Plaza lobby and escort them to the demo room.
- Parking: We'll use Lot B and email license numbers after the ID upload.
- Agenda: we'll follow Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf (shared in Drive).

Grace — please coordinate the calendar invites and add the Visitor_Passes.csv entries once Karina confirms upload. Also capture a 5-min pre-brief slot at 09:35 for team alignment (Jordan to host).

If anyone needs to update exec attendance in the next 12 hours, flag it here and copy Novapower Security. Otherwise, we are set.

See you tomorrow — Hannah
